title: CultNet Error Message v1
description: cultnet.error.v0 plus messageId (write-receipt.md). Sent in place of cultnet.error.v0 only to a connection that declared the write-receipt capability. v0 is unchanged: its schema is closed (additionalProperties false), so an extra key would make a v0 peer reject the frame instead of ignoring it. Map-mode: every key is written, messageId nil when the error answers no readable message. The code enum is the v0 enum.

routingHint.description: Optional shard routing detail for an authority failure. Null for every selection/cursor refusal code (R-N).

code.description: Machine-readable refusal code (R-N). Additive: a v0 peer that does not know this field ignores it. The set is a closed enum: Rust and TypeScript refuse a message whose code is not listed, so adding a code is one coordinated change across every runtime (this schema, the C# factory, the Rust CultNetErrorCode, and a captured-bytes case for each). limit_reached: a receipt-capable server refuses a NEW write because its per-session remembered-write table (1024 entries) or its server-wide memory budget is full; messageId is the write's id.

details.description: Code-specific structured detail (R-N). Every field is populated only for the code that defines it; the others are null, not omitted.

field.description: selection_invalid: the selection field that failed. variant_unsupported: "subscriptionId", when a subscription was ended. unowned_schema: "schemaId". write_not_authorized: "recordKey". unsupported_schema_version: "schemaVersion". message_invalid: the request field that is missing or ill-typed ("message" when the whole frame cannot be read). limit_reached: no field; details stay all null. message_invalid also names "messageId" (over 256 bytes), "document", "schemaId" or "channel" (write on an unreliable channel).

value.description: selection_invalid: the offending value, when there is one string worth naming. variant_unsupported: the id of the subscription that ended. unowned_schema: the schema id no shard owns. write_not_authorized: the key of the refused write. unsupported_schema_version: the schemaVersion the peer does not speak.

asOf.description: cursor_stale: the cursor's own minted asOf.

current.description: cursor_stale: the answering server's current asOf.

messageId.description: The messageId of the write (or other request) this error answers, echoed byte for byte. Null only when the frame was unreadable or carried no messageId.
